title: Wilson–Cowan: Populations of Neurons
subtitle: From spiking networks to activity equations and beyond mean field: a guided reading of Chow & Karimipanah (2020)
meta: Companion to C. C. Chow and Y. Karimipanah, “Before and beyond the Wilson–Cowan equations”, J. Neurophysiol. 123 (2020) 1645–1656, and to H. R. Wilson and J. D. Cowan (1972). Every simulation in this book is computed by XPPAUT through pyauto-xpp; the code behind each figure is one click away.

parts.title: From Spikes to Populations
parts.blurb: Why we describe groups of neurons by a single number, their activity; what one recurrent population can do on its own (switch, remember, jump); and where the S-shaped gain function at the heart of every activity equation comes from.
